class DenselyNormedField (α : Type*) extends NormedField α where
  /-- The range of the norm is dense in the collection of nonnegative real numbers. -/
  lt_norm_lt : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x < y → ∃ a : α, x < ‖a‖ ∧ ‖a‖ < y
